title: security-01
description: security-01 · 192.168.72.2 · role security · a KVM virtual machine on grey-server.

targets.expr: 100 - (avg by (host) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle", host="security-01"}[$__rate_interval]) and on (host, cpu) (node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle", host="security-01"} > 0)) * 100)

panels.title: Load per core
panels.description: One-minute load divided by core count.

targets.expr: node_load1{host="security-01"} / on (host) group_left () count by (host) (count by (host, cpu) (node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle", host="security-01"} > 0))

panels.title: Memory used
panels.description: Against MemAvailable, so page cache counts as free.

panels.title: CPU by mode
panels.description: Normalised to one core, so the stack tops out at 100%.

targets.expr: sum by (mode) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{host="security-01", mode!="idle"}[$__rate_interval])) / on () group_left () count(count by (cpu) (node_cpu_seconds_total{host="security-01"})) * 100
